name: IEWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: First held by Fast Eddie at the fed's own founding; held by the Vulture entering 22 September 1997 undefeated since March, and lost that night to Leeb in sixteen seconds after an Armageddon ambush, the shortest title match on the fed's own record.

name: IEWA World Television Championship
epitaph: First held by Dave Scar at the fed's own founding; held by the Vulture alongside the World Heavyweight belt as of 22 September 1997, with this collection's holdings not tracing the lineage between the two or showing it change hands after.

name: IEWA North American Championship
epitaph: Briefly held by Fast Eddie alongside the World Heavyweight Title at the fed's own founding and vacated under its one-title rule; no successor survives in this collection's holdings.

name: IEWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Contested only in a hardcore-rules match, added to the fed's slate by mid-January 1997; retained by "Kryokiller" Ken Wilson over Thunder Rider in a 60-minute Iron Man match, 9 falls to 8, on 22 September 1997.

name: IEWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: First held by Skull & Dave Douglas at the fed's own founding; held by Damage (Kain & Die Maschine) entering 22 September 1997, and lost that night to the Horsemen (Rig & Lord Nightmare).
